initialHtmlAnchors.text: 02M02Neural Networks: Layers & ArchitectureFrom $79, Module 1 freeBuild a neuron, apply activations, connect layers, count parameters, and prepare input batches for an untrained classifier.
03M03Training: Loss, Gradients & Optimization🔒Calculate loss and gradients, update weights, control training, and evaluate predictions on separate readings.
04M04Browser ML Runtimes🔒Set up a browser runtime, export and load model files, run repeated predictions, and compare three JavaScript ML tools.
05M05Signal Processing🔒Inspect frequencies, track them over time, taper window edges, and turn signal measurements into model features.
06M06Recurrent Networks🔒Build recurrent models, inspect memory updates, create time-ordered windows, and split the stream before evaluation to avoid overlap.
07M07Anomaly Detection🔒Define a normal baseline, train an autoencoder, measure reconstruction error, tune thresholds, and combine three detector votes.
08M08Advanced Time-Series🔒Explore attention, forecasting, Kalman filters, and ensembles. Compare their assumptions and check their errors.
09M09LLM Integration🔒Build prompts, retrieve evidence from logs, validate generated claims, and connect several models into a reporting pipeline.
10M10Optimization & Edge🔒Profile a model, reduce weight precision, test pruning, cache predictions, and compare GPU backends. Measure size, speed, memory, and prediction changes separately.
11M11Capstone: Deploy DEEP SCAN🔒Connect the system, build release checks, monitor behavior, document the model, and rehearse training and deployment.
